Parameter.name: TaskName
Parameter.Description: This defines the user-visible name of this task; This is defined in subclasses.

Property.name: DaysToKeep
Property.Description: Number of days to keep (based on when message was created/added to the queue)

Method.name: OnTask
Method.Description:
This method is responsible for executing the task.
At the scheduled time, the Task Manager creates an instance of this object, sets any property values using the stored "settings" for the task, and then invokes this method to execute the task.
In order to execute a real task, override this method in a subclass.
